pages.text: $(bold)Sweat drops$(): while Sweaty Feet, little droplets keep rising around your feet — more at higher levels (can be disabled).$(br2)$(bold)Stink particles$(): green particles around the feet at sweat level 3, and around barefoot fungus-infected players.

$(bold)Sneezes$(): during foot fungus you sneeze every 3 seconds (can be disabled).$(br2)$(bold)Splash$(): water splashes and bubbles from washing, filling the basin and rinsing boots — purely cosmetic.
